inlines.v: ARISTOCRAT'ICAL, a. 1. Pertaining to aristocracy; consisting in a government of nobles, or principal men; as an aristocratic constitution.2. Partaking of aristocracy; as, an aristocratic measure; aristocratic pride or manners.
